issues.title: Missing Dependency Context
issues.why: The spec references 13 sub-files (01-13) and external files like 'src/index.css' and 'tailwind.config.ts' which are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Provide the content of 01-design-principles.md and 02-theme-variable-architecture.md to resolve token and principle definitions.

issues.title: Concurrency/Race Condition in Font Loading
issues.why: AC-007/008/009 mandate 'display=swap' but don't specify behavior for slow networks where system fonts might cause Layout Shift (CLS) before the 300ms motion budget.
issues.fix: Add a requirement for a CSS 'font-display: swap' with specific size-adjust overrides to minimize CLS during font swap.

issues.title: Incomplete Code Block Examples
issues.why: While logic for loaders is provided in Go/PHP/Python, the actual CSS implementation for the 'gradient underline sweep' (AC-027) is described but not shown as a code snippet.
issues.fix: Include a CSS snippet for the .nav-item::after origin-flip logic to ensure 100% CSS accuracy.
